# telnyx_sim_card_data_usage_notification (Data Source)

Sends a notification when a SIM card's data usage reaches a threshold.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `record_type` (String)
- `sim_card_id` (String) The identification UUID of the related SIM card resource.
- `threshold` (Attributes) Data usage threshold that will trigger the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--threshold))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String)
- `unit` (String) One of `GB`, `MB`.
